background.value: Plain and white. Photographs with dark, busy or patterned backgrounds will not be accepted.

head_height.value: Close-up of head and top of shoulders; the face should take up 70-80% of the vertical dimension of the photograph (no absolute mm figure published on this page)

validity.value: Photos must not be older than six (6) months

file_spec.value: Must be printed on photo-quality (non-glossy) paper in high resolution; only original prints are accepted — scanned or photocopied photos are not accepted

clothing_restriction.value: Normal/casual attire, without wearing a hat or dark glasses

expression_restriction.value: Applicant must look directly towards the camera portraying a neutral expression; smiles, frowning, raised eyebrows or unusual expressions are not acceptable

glasses_policy.value: Eyes must be shown clearly with no light reflection off the glasses and no tinted lenses; heavy frames should be avoided if possible. Dark glasses / non-prescription tinted glasses are not acceptable unless medically necessary, in which case a medical certificate is required.

face_visibility.value: Both edges of the face shall be clearly visible

headwear_policy.value: Head coverings shall not be accepted except in circumstances specifically approved by the competent authority; religious headwear worn daily requires a signed statement confirming this practice

expression.en: Look directly towards the camera with a neutral expression; smiles, frowning, raised eyebrows or unusual expressions are not acceptable.
expression.ko: 카메라를 정면으로 응시하며 무표정을 유지해야 한다. 미소, 찡그림, 눈썹 치켜올리기 등 부자연스러운 표정은 허용되지 않는다.
expression.ja: カメラを正面から直視し、無表情を保つこと。笑顔、しかめ面、眉を上げるなどの不自然な表情は認められない。

glasses.en: Eyes must be shown clearly with no reflection off the glasses and no tinted lenses; heavy frames should be avoided where possible. Dark glasses are not acceptable unless medically necessary (certificate required).
glasses.ko: 안경 착용 시 렌즈에 빛 반사가 없어야 하며 색이 있는 렌즈는 불가하다. 두꺼운 안경테는 가급적 피해야 한다. 짙은 색 선글라스는 의료상 필요한 경우(진단서 필요) 외에는 허용되지 않는다.
glasses.ja: 眼鏡を着用する場合、レンズへの反射がなく、色付きレンズも不可。太いフレームはできるだけ避けること。濃い色のサングラスは医学的理由(診断書が必要)がない限り認められない。

headwear.en: Head coverings are not accepted except in circumstances specifically approved by the competent authority; religious headwear worn daily requires a signed statement confirming this practice.
headwear.ko: 머리가리개(모자 등)는 관계 당국이 특별히 승인한 경우를 제외하고 허용되지 않는다. 매일 착용하는 종교적 머리가리개는 이를 확인하는 서명된 진술서가 필요하다.
headwear.ja: 頭部を覆うもの(帽子等)は、管轄当局が特別に承認した場合を除き認められない。日常的に着用する宗教上の頭覆いは、その旨を証明する署名済みの申立書が必要。

face_visibility.en: Both edges of the face shall be clearly visible.
face_visibility.ko: 얼굴 양쪽 가장자리(윤곽)가 뚜렷하게 보여야 한다.
face_visibility.ja: 顔の両端(輪郭)がはっきりと見える必要がある。

clothing.en: Normal/casual attire should be worn, without a hat or dark glasses.
clothing.ko: 일상적인 평상복을 착용해야 하며, 모자나 짙은 선글라스는 착용할 수 없다.
clothing.ja: 普段のカジュアルな服装を着用し、帽子や濃い色のサングラスは着用不可。

db_conflicts.research_value: Not stated as an absolute mm figure — official rule is 'face takes up 70-80% of the vertical dimension of the photograph'

cross_verification.note_en: Malta's identity/passport agency changed domain from identitymalta.com to identita.gov.mt; the old identitymalta.com domain now returns HTTP 403 on direct fetch. Two internal inconsistencies were found on identita.gov.mt itself during this research pass and were deliberately NOT used: (1) a PDF hosted at identita.gov.mt/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/Biometric-photos.pdf is titled 'Passport photographs' but its letterhead reads 'Home Office / Identity & Passport Service' and it cites a 'Passport Adviceline 0870 521 0410' (a UK phone number) and gives DIFFERENT figures (45mm x 35mm, light grey/cream background, 1 month old) — this is evidently a leftover/reused UK IPS document, not Maltese-authored content, so it was excluded entirely. (2) identita.gov.mt's own FAQ aggregator page (frequently-asked-questions/passport/) separately states '45mm x 35mm' and a 3-month validity, conflicting with the dedicated passport-office-sec-page-useful-info page used here (40mm x 30mm, 6 months). The dedicated page was preferred as primary because its language reads as genuine Malta-drafted regulatory text (references to 'the competent authority', a specific signed-statement exception process) rather than generic/templated content. Given this internal inconsistency on Malta's own official domain, the size and head_height figures reported here should be treated with appropriate caution despite being sourced from an official .gov.mt page.
